text:
Rae H.: Quick thought after today's PM: we need a compact follow-up ledger (one-row-per-action) + a lightweight IC rotation to ensure weekly triage.

Liam W.: Agreed. Compact ledger fields: Action | Owner | Due | SLA_h | AcceptanceCriteria | VerificationOwner | EvidenceLink | RecurrenceTag | State. Keep it single-sheet so teams adopt it.

Tori - oncall: I'll prototype sheet and a Slack workflow that pings owners 48h before SLA and escalates if missed. Prefer 4-week IC rotation with 1-week overlap for handoff.

incident-bot: [automated] I can post weekly digests and run escalation rules. Need config: ack_window=48h, reminder_offsets=[48,24], escalation_chain=[owner,backup,team_lead,oncall].

Risk Ops (June): Recurrence detection: auto-suggest tags when the same service or error signature appears in >=2 incidents in 60d. Flag as "review" if >=3 in 180d.

Rae H.: Pilot plan: run for next 8 PMs. Metrics: % acked within 48h, 7/30/90 closure rates, recurrence flags. Tori to post sheet link and rotation invites by next Monday (1856070000).

Liam W.: Small ask: require one-line AcceptanceCriteria for every action so verification is objective.

Tori - oncall: Will do. Adding owners now and will DM folks to volunteer for rotation. :white_check_mark:
